# AI Engineering Manager / Director of AI Engineering

> Leads AI engineering teams: hiring, delivery and technical direction for LLM and ML systems; usually reached after senior or staff individual-contributor work.

| Family | Work footprint | Evidence status | GenAI target | CCI rank | Résumé variant |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Leadership & Executive | Leadership and independent practice (plane) | Verified (V) | Leadership #1 (ranked separately) | Leadership #1 of 5 (ranked separately) | L1 AI Engineering Manager / Director |

Evidence status follows the [catalog's classes](../role-catalog.md#12-status-classes-for-canonical-roles). The GenAI target order and the CCI rank answer different questions: the [target order](../genai-target-roles.md) is restricted to GenAI work; the [CCI rank](../role-rankings.md) scores the role as a whole career. The work footprint is judgement (Grade D) from the [role map](../role-map.md).

## Who it suits

A leadership or independent track: people reach it after years of experience. When to target it: [GenAI target roles: leadership and independent tracks](../genai-target-roles.md#leadership-and-independent-tracks-when-to-target-them).

## What you need

- **Must (headline):** Leadership & mentoring, Stakeholder communication.
- **Important (headline):** GRC & risk assessment, System design, LLM evaluation (golden sets, calibrated judges, CI gates), Observability (OpenTelemetry traces, metrics), Capacity & GPU/API cost governance, Guardrails, AI strategy & portfolio.
- **Full inventory:** 44 skills (Must 4 · Important 16 · Should 17 · Optional 7), each with its evidence and posting keywords: [ai-engineering-manager.md](../../03-skills-and-tech/inventories/ai-engineering-manager.md).
- **Prerequisites:** Senior/Staff IC first; AI engineers move into management in under 3 years on average (SignalFire, C)
- What to learn first and what to drop across roles: [skills radar](../../03-skills-and-tech/skills-radar.md); in what order: [learning roadmaps](../../03-skills-and-tech/learning-roadmaps.md).
